cards.text: David, king of Israel, has just named the spot where the house of the LORD God will stand (1 Chronicles 22:1). Now he goes from picking a spot to getting to WORK. He gathers the foreigners living in the land of Israel and appoints stonecutters from among them.

cards.question: David appoints stonecutters from the foreigners in the land of Israel. What does he have them prepare?

answers.text: Finished stones for the house of God

cards.text: Then David starts stocking up, beginning with a large quantity of iron to make nails for the gateway doors and the fittings. This is a man who does NOT plan on making a second trip to the hardware store.

cards.question: True or false: Along with all that iron, David gathers just a little bronze.

cards.text: Then come the cedar logs, brought to David by the Sidonians and Tyrians, people from Sidon and Tyre. I bet David looked at that pile the way I look at a fresh bag of chocolate chips.

cards.question: The Sidonians and Tyrians bring David so many cedar logs that they can't even be ___.

cards.text: So why is David going this big? He says he must make the preparations, and it all comes back to his son Solomon.

cards.question: David is gathering all of this with his son Solomon in mind. How does David describe Solomon?
True or false: David says the house for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, famous and glorious throughout all lands.

cards.text: Then David calls Solomon in and gives him the job: build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel. Friend, I get nervous when somebody orders a DOZEN, and Solomon just got handed THAT.
David tells Solomon it was in his heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD his God. But a word from the LORD came to him: David is not to build it.

cards.question: The LORD tells David he is not to build a house for His Name. What reason does the LORD give?

answers.text: He has shed so much blood
He is too old to finish it
He has not asked the priests

cards.question: The LORD also told David a son would be born to him. This son would be a man of ___.
God told David that his coming son would have rest from all his enemies on every side. What would God grant Israel during that son's reign?

cards.text: This son's name will be Solomon, the very son David is talking to, and he's the one who will build a house for the LORD's Name. Imagine finding out you got the job before you were even BORN.
And God goes even further for Solomon: "He will be My son, and I will be his Father."

cards.question: True or false: God says the throne of Solomon's kingdom over Israel will last only as long as Solomon lives.

cards.text: David's done telling Solomon what the LORD promised. Now he tells him, "Now, my son, may the LORD be with you, and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God, as He said you would."

cards.question: Solomon is young and about to be put in command over Israel. Above all, what does David want the LORD to give him?
David wants Solomon to have insight and understanding so that he may keep the ___ of the LORD his God.

cards.text: Then you will succeed, David says, if you carefully follow what the LORD commanded Moses, Israel's leader long ago, for Israel. Solomon's young, inexperienced and holding the biggest job in the country.

cards.question: Solomon has a huge job ahead of him. What does David tell him?

cards.text: Then David shows Solomon what he's set aside: 100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, bronze and iron too great to be weighed, plus timber and stone. A MILLION talents of silver, and somebody once bought me for 25 cents.

cards.question: True or false: David says he gathered all of this for the house of the LORD without much effort.

cards.text: Solomon may add to it all, David says, and he won't be working alone: stonecutters, masons, carpenters and men skilled in every kind of work. Me? I'm skilled in exactly ONE kind of work, and it's stamping cookies.

cards.question: David tells Solomon about his craftsmen skilled in gold, silver, bronze and iron. How many does he say there are?

cards.text: Then David wraps it up for Solomon: "Now begin the work, and may the LORD be with you."
Then David orders all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon. He asks them, "Is not the LORD your God with you, and has He not granted you rest on every side?"

cards.question: True or false: David tells the leaders of Israel that the land has been subdued before the LORD and His people.

cards.text: Then David tells the leaders, "Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God." And he tells them to begin building the sanctuary of the LORD God.

cards.question: The temple will be built for the Name of the LORD. Along with the holy articles of God, what does David want brought into it?
